<!--
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript section "Prevalence and Burden of Colibactin Mutagenesis". Describes summary statistics for the following:
- Prevalence of colibactin exposure,
- Comparisons of prevalence by cohort, nationality and anatomical location
- SBS88 / ID18 mutation burden, and its variation within and between patients
- Comparison of prevalence between children (this study) and adults (Lee-Six et al., Nature, 2019)
- Source data for Figure 2B
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = TRUE,
  message    = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  comment    = "#>",
  fig.path   = "../Figures/",
  fig.width  = 7,
  fig.height = 4,
  dpi        = 300
)

set.seed(42)
```

## Dependencies

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)    
library(lmerTest)     
library(broom.mixed)  
library(emmeans)      
```

## Data

```{r paths}
data_dir <- file.path("..", "Data")
```

```{r load-data}
crypt_metadata <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "biopsy_metadata.csv"))

crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "crypt_signature_attributions.csv")
)

lee_six_nature_2019 <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "lee_six_nature_2019_sbs_id_attribution.csv")
)
```

Two joined tables are used throughout. The join direction is **not**
interchangeable, so both are defined explicitly and reused rather than being
re-derived in every chunk:

* `crypts_attr_left` — signature attributions on the left, i.e. one row per
  crypt with attributions, annotated with biopsy metadata. Used for all
  prevalence counts.
* `crypts_meta_left` — biopsy metadata on the left. Used for the burden models,
  preserving the original behaviour of those chunks.

```{r joined-tables}
join_keys <- c("patient", "biopsy")
crypts_attr_left <- left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata, by = join_keys)
crypts_meta_left <- left_join(crypt_metadata, crypt_signature_attributions, by = join_keys)
```

# A. Prevalence of colibactin exposure

## A.i. Overall prevalence

```{r prevalence-overall}
n_patients <- n_distinct(crypt_signature_attributions$patient)

n_patients_pos <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  filter(patient_colibactin_pos) %>%
  pull(patient) %>%
  n_distinct()

n_biopsies_pos <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  filter(biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  pull(biopsy) %>%
  n_distinct()

prop_patients_pos <- round(n_patients_pos / n_patients * 100)

cat(sprintf("Total patients:                   n = %d\n", n_patients))
cat(sprintf("Patients positive:                n = %d\n", n_patients_pos))
cat(sprintf("Proportion of patients positive:  %d%%\n",   prop_patients_pos))
cat(sprintf("Biopsies positive:                n = %d\n", n_biopsies_pos))
```
## A.ii. Prevalence by nationality

```{r nationality-data}
nationality_df <- crypts_attr_left %>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient)) %>%
  mutate(nationality = factor(nationality, levels = c("UK", "Denmark")))

nationality_counts <- nationality_df %>%
  count(nationality, patient_colibactin_pos, name = "patients") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = patient_colibactin_pos, values_from = patients, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("nationality") %>%
  as.matrix()

nationality_counts
```

```{r nationality-summary}
n_uk_pos        <- nationality_counts["UK",      "TRUE"]
n_danish_pos    <- nationality_counts["Denmark", "TRUE"]
prop_uk_pos     <- round(n_uk_pos     / rowSums(nationality_counts)["UK"]      * 100)
prop_danish_pos <- round(n_danish_pos / rowSums(nationality_counts)["Denmark"] * 100)

cat(sprintf("UK patients:               n = %d\n", sum(nationality_counts["UK", ])))
cat(sprintf("UK patients positive:      n = %d (%d%%)\n", n_uk_pos, prop_uk_pos))
cat(sprintf("Danish patients:           n = %d\n", sum(nationality_counts["Denmark", ])))
cat(sprintf("Danish patients positive:  n = %d (%d%%)\n", n_danish_pos, prop_danish_pos))
```

Logistic regression for nationality, adjusted for sex, age and cohort.

```{r nationality-model}
nationality_model <- glm(
  patient_colibactin_pos ~ nationality + sex + age + cohort, data = nationality_df, family = binomial)

summary(nationality_model)$coefficients

nationality_p <- summary(nationality_model)$coefficients["nationalityDenmark", "Pr(>|z|)"]
cat(sprintf("Nationality (Denmark vs UK) p = %s\n", format.pval(nationality_p, digits = 3)))
```

## A.iii. Prevalence by cohort (IBD vs histologically normal)
Restricted to the UK cohort, which is the only one containing both groups.
```{r cohort-data}
cohort_df <- crypts_attr_left %>%
  filter(nationality == "UK") %>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))

cohort_counts <- cohort_df %>%
  count(cohort, patient_colibactin_pos, name = "patients") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = patient_colibactin_pos, values_from = patients, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cohort") %>%
  as.matrix()

cohort_counts
```

```{r cohort-summary}
n_normal_pos    <- cohort_counts["Normal", "TRUE"]
n_ibd_pos       <- cohort_counts["IBD",    "TRUE"]
prop_normal_pos <- round(n_normal_pos / rowSums(cohort_counts)["Normal"] * 100)
prop_ibd_pos    <- round(n_ibd_pos    / rowSums(cohort_counts)["IBD"]    * 100)

cat(sprintf("Histologically normal patients:            n = %d\n", sum(cohort_counts["Normal", ])))
cat(sprintf("Histologically normal patients positive:   n = %d (%d%%)\n", n_normal_pos, prop_normal_pos))
cat(sprintf("IBD patients:                              n = %d\n", sum(cohort_counts["IBD", ])))
cat(sprintf("IBD patients positive:                     n = %d (%d%%)\n", n_ibd_pos, prop_ibd_pos))
```

Logistic regression for cohort, adjusted for sex and age.

```{r cohort-model}
cohort_model <- glm(patient_colibactin_pos ~ cohort + sex + age, data   = cohort_df, family = binomial)
cohort_p <- summary(cohort_model)$coefficients["cohortNormal", "Pr(>|z|)"]
cat(sprintf("Cohort (Normal vs IBD) p = %s\n", format.pval(cohort_p, digits = 3)))
```
## A.iv. Spread in colibactin burden across crypts within a biopsy
Number and proportion of positive crypts per positive biopsy.

```{r crypts-per-biopsy-summary}
crypts_biopsy_sum <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  filter(biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  group_by(biopsy) %>%
  summarise(
    n_positive_crypts = sum(crypt_colibactin_pos),
    n_crypts          = n(),
    .groups           = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_crypts_positive = n_positive_crypts / n_crypts) %>%
  summarise(
    median_prop_pos               = median(prop_crypts_positive),
    median_count                  = median(n_positive_crypts),
    lqr                           = quantile(n_positive_crypts, 0.25),
    uqr                           = quantile(n_positive_crypts, 0.75),
    n_biopsies                    = n(),
    n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive = sum(prop_crypts_positive == 1),
    instances_one_pos_crypt        = sum(n_positive_crypts == 1)
  )

with(crypts_biopsy_sum, {
  cat(sprintf("Median positive crypts per biopsy:            %g [%g, %g]\n",
              median_count, lqr, uqr))
  cat(sprintf("Median proportion of crypts positive:         %g%%\n",
              median_prop_pos * 100))
  cat(sprintf("Biopsies with all crypts positive:            %d\n",
              n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive))
  cat(sprintf("Total positive biopsies:                      %d\n",
              n_biopsies))
  cat(sprintf("Proportion of biopsies with all crypts pos.:  %d%%\n",
              round(n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive / n_biopsies * 100)))
})
```

Variability of sensitivity-corrected burden within an individual, summarised as
the coefficient of variation (CV = SD / mean) of positive crypts per patient.
The median CV across patients is reported with its interquartile range.

```{r within-patient-cv}
cv_summary <- function(data, signature, sensitivity, group_var) {
  data %>%
    filter(crypt_colibactin_pos) %>%
    mutate(burden = {{ signature }} / {{ sensitivity }}) %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      mean    = mean(burden),
      sd      = sd(burden),
      cv      = sd / mean,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cv = mean(cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      low_cv    = quantile(cv, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      upp_cv    = quantile(cv, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}

sbs88_cv <- cv_summary(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$crypt_colibactin_pos==TRUE,], SBS88, sensitivitySBS, biopsy)
id18_cv  <- cv_summary(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$crypt_colibactin_pos==TRUE,], ID18,  sensitivityID,  biopsy)

cat(sprintf("SBS88 within-biopsy CV: %.2f IQR [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            sbs88_cv$mean_cv, sbs88_cv$low_cv, sbs88_cv$upp_cv))
cat(sprintf("ID18 within-biopsy CV:   %.2f IQR [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            id18_cv$mean_cv, id18_cv$low_cv, id18_cv$upp_cv))
```


## A.v. Prevalence by anatomical location

```{r location-frequency}
location_frequency <- crypts_attr_left %>%
  filter(location %in% c("Caecum", "Ascending", "Transverse", "Sigmoid", "Rectum")) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, site, biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  distinct()

location_frequency %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    pos_biopsies = sum(biopsy_colibactin_pos),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop = pos_biopsies / n)
```

Patients with biopsies from more than one site allow left vs right colon to be
compared within an individual.

```{r two-biopsy-donors}
donors_two_biopsies_df <- crypts_attr_left %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(biopsy) > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

n_two_biopsy_donors <- n_distinct(donors_two_biopsies_df$patient)

n_two_biopsy_donors_pos <- donors_two_biopsies_df %>%
  filter(patient_colibactin_pos) %>%
  pull(patient) %>%
  n_distinct()

cat(sprintf("Donors with two biopsies:           n = %d\n", n_two_biopsy_donors))
cat(sprintf("...of whom colibactin positive:     n = %d\n", n_two_biopsy_donors_pos))
```

Breakdown of positive biopsies by anatomical location, for positive patients
with two biopsies.

```{r two-biopsy-location-breakdown}
donors_two_biopsies_df %>%
  filter(patient_colibactin_pos, site %in% c("Left", "Right")) %>%
  distinct(patient, site, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, site, biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  mutate(
    summary = case_when(
      Left  & Right  ~ "Both positive",
      Left  & !Right ~ "Only left positive",
      !Left & Right  ~ "Only right positive",
      TRUE           ~ "Neither"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(summary, name = "n")
```

# B. Mutation burden of colibactin
## B.i. Summary metrics

Range of SBS88 and ID18 burdens across crypts carrying each signature, within
positive biopsies.

```{r burden-range}
burden_range <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  filter(biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  summarise(
    min_SBS88 = min(SBS88[SBS88 > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    max_SBS88 = max(SBS88[SBS88 > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ID18  = min(ID18[ID18 > 0],   na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ID18  = max(ID18[ID18 > 0],   na.rm = TRUE)
  )

with(burden_range, {
  cat(sprintf("SBS88 burden: %g - %g mutations\n", min_SBS88, max_SBS88))
  cat(sprintf("ID18 burden:  %g - %g mutations\n", min_ID18,  max_ID18))
})
```

## B.ii. Burden by biopsy location
Sensitivity-corrected burden in doubly positive crypts from positive biopsies,
modelled with a patient-level random intercept.

```{r burden-long-data}
signatures <- c("SBS88", "ID18")

burden_df <- crypts_meta_left %>%
  mutate(
    SBS88 = SBS88 / sensitivitySBS,
    ID18  = ID18  / sensitivityID
  ) %>%
  filter(SBS88 > 0, ID18 > 0, biopsy_colibactin_pos) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, sample, site, cohort, SBS88, ID18) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(signatures),
    names_to  = "signature",
    values_to = "count"
  )

location_df   <- dplyr::select(burden_df, -cohort)%>%
  mutate(site=factor(site, levels=c('Right','Left')))
ibd_normal_df <- burden_df
```

```{r location-model}
# Fit one mixed model per signature and return the tidied fixed effect of
# interest with a Wald 95% confidence interval. `term_prefix` is matched
# against the start of the coefficient name (e.g. "site" matches "siteRight"),
# so the code does not depend on how the factor levels happen to be labelled.
fit_burden_model <- function(sig, data, formula, term_prefix) {
  model <- lmer(formula, data = filter(data, signature == sig))

  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(startsWith(term, term_prefix)) %>%
    mutate(
      signature = sig,
      estimate  = round(estimate, 0),
      low_ci    = round(estimate - 1.96 * std.error, 0),
      upp_ci    = round(estimate + 1.96 * std.error, 0),
      p.value   = signif(p.value, 3)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(signature, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci, p.value)
}

location_results <- map_dfr(
  signatures, fit_burden_model,
  data        = location_df,
  formula     = count ~ site + (1 | patient),
  term_prefix = "site"
)

location_results %>%
  mutate(summary = sprintf("%s: %d mutations [%d, %d], p-value=%s",
                           signature, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci,
                           format.pval(p.value, digits = 2)))
```


## B.iii. Burden by cohort (IBD vs histologically normal)

Adjusted for colonic site.

```{r cohort-burden-model}
ibd_normal_results <- map_dfr(
  signatures, fit_burden_model,
  data        = ibd_normal_df,
  formula     = count ~ site + cohort + (1 | patient),
  term_prefix = "cohort"
)

ibd_normal_results %>%
  mutate(summary = sprintf("%s: %d [%d, %d], P = %s",
                           signature, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci,
                           format.pval(p.value, digits = 3)))
```

## B.iv. Prevalence in children vs adults

SBS88 / ID18 attributions from this study are compared with adult normal colonic
crypts from Lee-Six et al., *Nature*, 2019.

```{r adult-prevalence}
adult_prevalence <- lee_six_nature_2019 %>%
  filter(age > 18) %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(
    patient_colibactin_pos = dplyr::first(patient_colibactin_pos),
    .groups                = "drop"
  ) %>%
  count(patient_colibactin_pos, name = "adult") %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient_colibactin_pos")

n_adult_pos    <- adult_prevalence["TRUE", ]
prop_adult_pos <- round(n_adult_pos / sum(adult_prevalence) * 100)

cat(sprintf("Colibactin prevalence in adults: %d%% (n = %d individuals)\n",
            prop_adult_pos, n_adult_pos))
```

```{r child-adult-data}
adults_summary <- lee_six_nature_2019 %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, patient_colibactin_pos, age, sex) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(cohort = if_else(age > 18, "adult", "paediatric"))

children_summary <- crypts_attr_left %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, patient_colibactin_pos, age, sex) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(cohort = if_else(age > 18, "adult", "paediatric"))

compare_adult_children <- bind_rows(children_summary, adults_summary) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("paediatric", "adult")))

count(compare_adult_children, cohort, patient_colibactin_pos)
```

```{r child-adult-model}
adult_children_model <- glm(
  patient_colibactin_pos ~ cohort,
  data   = compare_adult_children,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

pairs(emmeans(adult_children_model, ~ cohort), type = "response")
```
